request_body.title: Реки: продукт
request_body.description: Total observed (90d), rolling MAU/WAU, UTC DAU, cohort D1/D7, weekly inactivity churn and segments. Summary/cohort panels use 90d; trends use selected range. Small samples; NULL means not yet measurable.

panels.title: Пользователи: total / MAU / WAU / DAU
panels.description: Наблюдаемые игроки за 90 дней; не размер базы аккаунтов. MAU = последние 30×24ч, WAU = 7×24ч, DAU = UTC сегодня (неполный день) и вчера.

queries.query:
SELECT 'Все игроки' AS segment,
 count(DISTINCT player_id) AS observed_users,
 to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)) AS telemetry_since_utc,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 30 * 86400000000 THEN player_id END) AS mau_30d,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 7 * 86400000000 THEN player_id END) AS wau_7d,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) THEN player_id END) AS dau_today,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 1 THEN player_id END) AS dau_yesterday
FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''

panels.title: DAU по дням (UTC)
panels.description: Уникальные real player_id; крайние дни выбранного периода могут быть неполными.

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 day') AS day, count(DISTINCT player_id) AS dau
FROM "product" WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Первое появление в выбранном периоде
panels.description: Первое наблюдаемое событие в диапазоне; не регистрации новых аккаунтов.

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(first_seen, '1 day') AS day, count(*) AS new_players
FROM (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen FROM "product" WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Пользователи и публикации по сегментам
panels.description: 90 дней. Сегмент игрока по непустым значениям; несколько значений → multi-world / multi-age-group / multi-platform. unknown сохраняется. Строки разных измерений не складывать.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen, max(_timestamp) AS last_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(age_group, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(age_group, '')), 'unknown') END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform'
 ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_publish' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saw_result
FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id, first_seen, last_seen, published, saw_result FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id, first_seen, last_seen, published, saw_result FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'platform' AS dimension, platform AS segment, player_id, first_seen, last_seen, published, saw_result FROM players)
SELECT dimension, segment, count(*) AS observed_users,
 sum(CASE WHEN last_seen >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 30 * 86400000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mau_30d,
 sum(CASE WHEN last_seen >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 7 * 86400000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wau_7d,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(last_seen / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dau_today,
 sum(published) AS publishers, round(100.0 * sum(published) / count(*), 1) AS publish_pct
FROM segments GROUP BY dimension, segment ORDER BY dimension, observed_users DESC

panels.title: Когорты: D1 / D7
panels.description: Первое появление в 90 днях, точный день возврата UTC. Только дни до последнего дня телеметрии. NULL = окно ещё не завершено.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen, max(_timestamp) AS last_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(age_group, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(age_group, '')), 'unknown') END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform'
 ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_publish' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saw_result
FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id),
 activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''),
 watermark AS (SELECT floor(max(_timestamp) / 86400000000) AS day FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '')
SELECT to_timestamp_micros(floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) * 86400000000) AS cohort_day,
 count(*) AS cohort_users,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_d1,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day AND a1.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_d1,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day AND a1.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
 nullif(sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS retention_d1_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_d7,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day AND a7.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
 nullif(sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS retention_d7_pct
FROM players p CROSS JOIN watermark w
LEFT JOIN activity a1 ON p.player_id = a1.player_id AND a1.day = floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1
LEFT JOIN activity a7 ON p.player_id = a7.player_id AND a7.day = floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7
GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day

panels.title: Недельный churn: все и сегменты
panels.description: Прокси неактивности: активен в предыдущие полные 7 UTC-дней, отсутствует в последние полные 7. NULL до 14 дней истории или при нулевом знаменателе. Не отмена подписки.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen, max(_timestamp) AS last_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(age_group, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(age_group, '')), 'unknown') END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform'
 ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_publish' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saw_result
FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (
 SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players
 UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'platform' AS dimension, platform AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 activity AS (SELECT player_id,
 max(CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_week,
 max(CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id),
 coverage AS (SELECT min(_timestamp) AS first_event FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '')
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN sum(a.previous_week) END AS eligible_users,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN sum(CASE WHEN a.previous_week = 1 AND a.last_week = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS inactive_users,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN a.previous_week = 1 AND a.last_week = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(a.previous_week), 0), 1) END AS weekly_churn_pct
FROM segments s JOIN activity a ON s.player_id = a.player_id CROSS JOIN coverage c
GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment ORDER BY s.dimension, s.segment

panels.title: Активация: публикация → результат
panels.description: Игроки с post_publish и post_result среди наблюдаемых за 90 дней. Это охват событий, не упорядоченная воронка первой сессии.

queries.query:
SELECT 'Наблюдаемые игроки' AS population, count(*) AS observed_users,
 sum(published) AS publishers, sum(saw_result) AS result_users,
 round(100.0 * sum(published) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS publish_pct,
 round(100.0 * sum(saw_result) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS result_pct
FROM (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen, max(_timestamp) AS last_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(age_group, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(age_group, '')), 'unknown') END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform'
 ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_publish' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saw_result
FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id)

panels.title: Сессии и события
panels.description: По выбранному периоду. Не все серверные события имеют session_id.

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 day') AS day, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, count(*) AS events
FROM "product" WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: События и охват игроков
panels.description: Проверка полноты событий и продуктовой активности.

queries.query:
SELECT event_name, count(DISTINCT player_id) AS players, count(*) AS events
FROM "product" WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''
GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY events DESC
